messages:
maria: Quick design ask — new canary CTA placement on the rollout inspector. Dropped a Figma frame: https://figma.com/file/abc123 (see 'Canary CTA v2'). Thoughts on discoverability vs accidental taps?
alex: I like the left-aligned CTA next to the variant chips — it reads as action for that variant. But worried about mobile cramped space.
cj: Agree with alex. Maybe collapse to icon-only at < 480px? We should keep a clear label for screen readers.
maria: Good call. Proposed responsive: full text on desktop, icon+sr-only on mobile. cc @sam for accessibility check.
sam: For screen readers use: `aria-label="Promote variant to canary (opens confirmation dialog)"`. Also ensure focus target is 44x44.
alex: UX nit — the CTA currently looks primary even when variant is inactive. Can we dim it until the variant has traffic >0? Otherwise users might think it's already enabled.
maria: Ooh true. Proposal: primary only when traffic > 0.8% (tiny threshold) otherwise ghost with tooltip "Enable traffic to promote". Thoughts?
cj: Tooltip copy maybe: "No traffic routed — promote to canary to start receiving traffic." Shorten to "No traffic routed — enable to promote."
sam: From A11y: tooltips need accessible trigger and escape key handling. Also ensure the tooltip is announced on focus.
deploy-bot: deploy-preview: canary-cta-v2 pushed to staging at http://staging.redwood/rollouts/inspector — snapshot at 1719801400
alex: Quick keyboard flow question — after promotion modal confirms, focus should land on the variant chip or the timeline scrubber? My vote: variant chip so users can adjust allocation.
maria: I prefer timeline scrubber because most users will tweak percentage right away. But maybe both — focus the scrubber and reveal a visible focus ring on the variant chip.
cj: Also let's add a tiny 'undo' snackbar after promote with keyboard shortcut (u) to revert within 10s. Accessibility: announce snackbar with polite assertive region.
sam: Implementation note: use `role="status" aria-live="polite"` for the snackbar, and provide `aria-pressed` state for the CTA toggle.
alex: typo — should be `aria-pressed` only for toggle-like buttons; promote is modal, so keep `aria-haspopup="dialog"` and then focus management.
maria: Good catch. I'll update the spec. I'll push revised Figma and updated copy: CTA label -> "Promote to canary", tooltip -> "Enable traffic to promote variant".
alex: LGTM. Small visual tweak request: increase contrast on ghost CTA hover (from #6b7280 to #374151).
cj: +1 on contrast. Also add keyboard-only visible focus outline for the icon-only state.
maria: Thanks everyone — I'll iterate and post updated frames. If no major objections by EOD I'll ship the staging preview to product for validation. :rocket:
